businesses.business: specialty insurance wholesale brokerage and underwriting management

offering_description.value: Provides distribution, underwriting, product development and administration services for specialty property, casualty and professional lines insurance. Acts as a wholesale broker and managing general underwriter, connecting retail brokers and agents with insurance carriers.

primary_services.value: wholesale insurance brokerage; managing general underwriting; binding authority programs; insurance product development; program and claims administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: retail insurance brokers and agents, and insurance carriers seeking specialty risk distribution

end_markets.value: specialty property and casualty insurance; professional liability; excess and surplus lines; commercial insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions from carriers on placed premiums, plus fees for underwriting management and program administration

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places specialty risks from retail brokers with insurance carriers and manages underwriting on carriers' behalf

geography_served.value: global: US headquartered, with operations in North America, the UK and Europe, including Lloyd's of London

specialization.value: related lines: wholesale brokerage, binding authority, and managing general underwriting for specialty insurance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: brokers and underwriters working directly with retail agents and carriers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed insurance brokerage and managing general agent activity regulated by state insurance departments and UK regulators
